The headings of the fourth content are "How Do Subcontractor Statements Work?", "Purpose of Subcontractor Statements", "What is included in a Subcontractor Statement?", "Do I need to provide/obtain a Subcontractor Statement?", "Consequences of failing to provide/obtain a Subcontractor Statement", and "Key Takeaways".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A subcontractor statement is a written contract between a subcontractor and principal contractor. It is provided by a subcontractor and applies to specified periods of subcontracted work, most commonly performing work on a construction site.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Through subcontractor statements, subcontractors declare that they have met insurance premium payment, payroll tax payment and remuneration obligations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Subcontractor statements also give the subcontractor the right to work on the principal contractor’s project, be paid for working on the project and take full responsibility in case of non-compliance with the law.
